author: aclater
tagline: SACD disc images as DSF and WAV files over SMB and NFS
description:
sacdfs serves the SACD disc images (ISO files) in a folder as DSF and WAV files, read-only,
over SMB and NFS v4. Players and file managers see one folder per disc, with one file per
track; nothing is extracted or written to disk.

It has no web UI. Mount the share from a client: SMB on port 10445
(smb://<this server>:10445/sacd) and NFS v4 on port 12049 (<this server>:/sacd).

tips.before_install:
Choose the folder that holds your SACD images (ISO files) for /images; it is mounted read-only.
Without SMB_USER and SMB_PASSWORD the share is open to the whole network as a read-only guest share.
The container needs /dev/fuse and the capabilities listed in the compose file to mount FUSE;
it is not privileged.

title: sacdfs
